method: Live Qloo evidence versus no Qloo evidence; fixed eligible catalog and constraints; baseline includes the same known cuisine mappings; deterministic ranking and least-used-first plan control. No LLM calls, no generic-LLM benchmark, no user preference or clinical outcome measurement.
queryPolicy: restaurant-genre namespace only; at most 40 returned connections
rankingPolicy: direct recipe/tag mapping matches + 2 times strongest mapped affinity - 3 times dislike matches; least-used-first deterministic plan control
